name: Unidentified species
description: This species was a bipedal humanoid sentient species that existed in the galaxy. They were distinguished by their green skin, with mottled dark spots over their faces, and green and blonde hair. In 9 ABY, a member of this species was present at Gor Koresh's Honky Tonk when Koresh attempted to take Din Djarin's Mandalorian armor.
